_comment: EVERY Google billing number in this application lives in this file.
No price, free allowance, or quota literal may appear in places/, geo/,
coverage/, search/, or export/ code. Business logic asks the pricing
service instead: classify(fieldMask), remaining(sku), wouldExceed(sku, n).
The values below are UNVERIFIED starting points. Confirm them against the
Google Cloud billing page before the first real run and set verified:true.
Correcting them is a config change, never a code change.
_fieldTiersComment: Maps each field-mask entry to the SKU it forces. Classification is
data-driven so that adding a field cannot silently change the billing
tier: one Enterprise field bills the ENTIRE request at Enterprise.
Phone and website are Enterprise and are both required by the product,
so every lead-search call is an Enterprise call.
